test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Such was the confusion (1)/ that the instructions not only delayed (2)/ but also resulted in errors (3)/ across departments. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part 2 of the sentence: "that the instructions not only delayed."
 
• The phrase "not only delayed" is incomplete without its corresponding verb, which should ensure proper parallelism.
 
• The correct construction should be: "not only caused delays but also resulted in errors."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Such was the confusion that the instructions not only caused delays but also resulted in errors across departments."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Such was the confusion"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "but also resulted in errors"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "across departments"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
